newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon rates C&W "strong buy". [CORRECTED 13:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon rates C&W "strong buy". [CORRECTED 13:10 GMT]

text.p: Cable & Wireless Plc was rated "strong buy" at Salomon Brothers as the brokerage reinstated coverage of the stock, a research note by analyst Andrew Harrington said.
(Corrects name of brokerage in title and text, from Goldman Sachs to Salomon Brothers).
The brokerage said the key issue facing Cable & Wireless was how to maximise the value of its far-flung but incomplete asset base in a world of well-capitalised global rivals.
It said it believed C&W's management would address this issue, possibly through an alliance with an existing global telecoms group.
Salomon added the stock could be worth up to 750p per share or $35 per American Depository Receipt if such an alliance materialised.
The stock was up 10p at 459 by 1301 GMT, boosted by a repeated "buy" rating from BZW.
